# Follow or Bounce

> Personal site of Dmitrii V: a hand-built index of interactive field guides, dictionaries, instruments (audio and visual synthesizers, shaders, a border graph) and long-form essays on waves, perception, electronics, spaceflight, measurement and design. Everything is static HTML on GitHub Pages; each page is self-contained and readable without JavaScript where possible.

Home: https://followorbounce.github.io/  
Sitemap: https://followorbounce.github.io/sitemap.xml

## Design & Experience

- [Dictionary of Design](https://followorbounce.github.io/dictionary-of-design/): 113 art/design terms, illustrated with a small reusable abstract-vector visual grammar — “design of the external world.”
- [Dictionary of Inner Experience](https://followorbounce.github.io/dictionary-of-inner-experience/): 77 emotion/mood/existential terms, its own reusable visual grammar — “design of inner experience.”

## Waves

- [Universal Waves](https://followorbounce.github.io/universal-waves): Master index of every wave family in nature: mechanical, electromagnetic, matter, plasma, gravitational, chemical, biological, information, astronomical, plus the shared mathematics.
- [Waves — Sound, Light & Vibration](https://followorbounce.github.io/waves): Sound, light, seismic motion, and matter waves.
- [Music Is Mathematics](https://followorbounce.github.io/music-mathematics): String physics, harmonics, equal temperament, digital audio, radio, cosmic resonance, and a nine-tool audio lab.
- [Perception — Visual & Auditory Illusions](https://followorbounce.github.io/perception-illusions): Visual and auditory illusions as evidence for the brain as an inference engine, not a recorder.

## Radio & Electronics

- [Electronics — Components to Microcontrollers](https://followorbounce.github.io/electronics): Resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transistors, logic gates, the 555 timer, and a semiconductor-physics deep dive; six interactive demos.
- [Radio Communications](https://followorbounce.github.io/radio-communications): Frequency, modulation, propagation, spacecraft links, and spectrum management; a real FFT SDR waterfall.
- [Media Servers](https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers): Generative art, real-time rendering, GLSL shaders, projection mapping, and signal processing.
- [Media Servers II](https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers-shaders): A real compiled GLSL shader, 3D projection mapping, Gerstner ocean waves, Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, and curl-noise flow fields.

## Making & Fabrication

- [Photolithography — Printing With Light](https://followorbounce.github.io/photolithography): From Niépce's 1827 bitumen heliograph to 8 nm EUV: resist chemistry, the process step by step, spin coating, an exposure simulator, shrinking a mask through a microscope, and any picture as a printable dot matrix — with safety notes.

## Instruments

- [Password & Passphrase Generator](https://followorbounce.github.io/password-generator): Client-side only, Web Crypto API, canonical BIP-39 wordlist, no network calls.
- [Life in Weeks](https://followorbounce.github.io/life-in-weeks): Enter a date of birth: every week lived on a 100- or 120-year grid, the world-average life expectancy marked, exact calendar counts and labelled body averages. Nothing leaves the browser.

## Audio Synth

- [Audio Synths](https://followorbounce.github.io/audio-synths/): Hub for every sound instrument: SoundOS (desktop only), Pulse Train — Stage II (mobile & desktop), the Node Database, the homepage live rig and the archive.
- [SoundOS](https://followorbounce.github.io/soundos/): A browser modular synthesizer builder: patch nodes with cables, hit Generate and it oscillates continuously like a powered-on rack, with per-node record-and-loop of knob moves.
- [Pulse Train — Stage II](https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train-stage-ii): Thirteen units across five labeled groups, with a patchable LFO carrying its own modulation scale per destination.
- [Node Database](https://followorbounce.github.io/pulse-train-node-database): Every node in Pulse Train — Stage II, explained three ways: software DSP, underlying math, and real hardware.

## Video Synth

- [Video Synths](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/): Hub for every live image-making piece: four WebGL installation studies and five visual instruments.
- [Point Cloud Scan](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/point-cloud-scan): Procedural 3D point-cloud scans (terrain, vaulted nave, tree, knot, or your image as depth) swept by a scanning plane and eroded by a noise-field decomposition front.
- [Displacement Field](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/displacement-field): Hidden-line sheet displaced by fractal noise, wave interference, an image, your camera, or a live microphone spectrogram.
- [Latent Flow](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/latent-flow): Up to a million GPU particles advected by a divergence-free ABC fluid flow, morphing between sculptural forms.
- [Data Matrix](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/data-matrix): Pixel-exact black-and-white data composition: barcodes, binary fields, waveform plots and a perspective data plane, with optional sine/click sound.
- [Photogrammetry Scan](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/photogrammetry-scan): A real Structure-from-Motion reconstruction (a downtown high-rise block, 225k coloured points, 251 solved cameras) to orbit or fly along its capture path, with scan-plane and decomposition effects; loads your own Meshroom .abc or .ply.
- [Light Grid](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/light-grid): Black-and-white light installation study: a lattice of squares and circles that rotate, breathe, outline, run as bars, flip in counterphase and ripple into moiré rings on a travelling wave; signed-distance fragment shader with full controls.
- [Palette Synth](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/palette-synth): A live cosine-gradient color instrument — twelve knobs generate a full smooth palette in real time.
- [Additive Wave Sculptor](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/additive-wave-sculptor): Eight-harmonic Fourier synthesis, playable as real audio via a Web Audio PeriodicWave.
- [Lissajous / Harmonograph Plotter](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/lissajous-plotter): Two axes, each a two-term sine sum, plotted against each other with amplitude decay.
- [Spectral Visualizer](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/spectral-visualizer): A real-time FFT spectrum analyzer and waveform oscilloscope driven by microphone, file, or internal oscillator.
- [Complex-Plane Fractal Mapper](https://followorbounce.github.io/visual-synths/complex-fractal-mapper): A Mandelbrot/Julia explorer colored with Palette Synth's own gradient formula.

## Systems & Development

- [Node-Based Software Development](https://followorbounce.github.io/node-based-development): An interactive field guide to visual/node programming, including a working drag-and-connect node-graph playground.

## Research & Method

- [The Verification Field Manual](https://followorbounce.github.io/field-manual): A practical handbook for finding, verifying, and preserving information across the web and academic archives.
- [Blockchain Infrastructure](https://followorbounce.github.io/blockchain-infrastructure): Distributed systems, consensus, cryptography, smart contracts, and DAOs — neutral and non-speculative, with real crypto.subtle demos.

## Explorers & Apps

- [Anatomy Explorer](https://followorbounce.github.io/anatomy-explorer/): An interactive 3D human body built from 1,635 real BodyParts3D structures — skeleton, muscles, organs, vessels, brain — with blood-flow and nerve-signal pulses.
- [World Calendar Explorer](https://followorbounce.github.io/world-calendar-explorer/): Convert any Gregorian date across 28 historical and contemporary calendar systems, with verified conversion math.
- [Country Comparison Atlas](https://followorbounce.github.io/country-atlas/): A living global atlas of 205 countries and territories, compared side by side across sourced core statistics.
- [US States Atlas](https://followorbounce.github.io/us-states-atlas/): Compare any two U.S. states on a tile grid or map, plus a government view of party control across four layers.

## Philosophy

- [The Ark of Consciousness](https://followorbounce.github.io/ark-of-consciousness): Logos, recording, learning, and the passage to the next layer of reality — an essay at the boundary of philosophy, cognitive science, information theory, machine learning, biology, and biblical theology.

## Project sites

Separate repositories served under the same host; several publish their own llms.txt.

- [Aerospace Knowledge Hub](https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/): 78 pages
- [Ju'un K'in](https://followorbounce.github.io/Maya-Calendar/): 7 pages
- [Heavy Machinery Encyclopedia](https://followorbounce.github.io/machinery/): 31 pages
- [Knot Atlas](https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/): 3D knot-tying guide (own llms.txt: https://followorbounce.github.io/knots/llms.txt)
- [Reckoning](https://followorbounce.github.io/reckoning/): interactive handbook of measure, shape, signals, weather, sky, ships and light
- [Tarot](https://followorbounce.github.io/tarot/): three public-domain tarot decks
